summary: v9.8.0 three-bug fixes VERIFIED on backend + frontend. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed (test_iter34_v980_three_bugs.py). Bug 1 (missing EXECUTE SEMI-AUTO on crypto cards): fixed — AISuggestionsSheet now renders 6x pink '⚡ EXECUTE SEMI-AUTO' buttons in card body (testID ai-trade-APT/MANA/AR/EGLD/KAVA/… observed, no expand required). Tapping opens AsiTradeSheet (observed APT LONG sheet with 'Trade dengan ASI-Bot (Semi-Auto)' header and HUBUNGKAN EXCHANGE CTA since test device has no exchange — valid non-error branch; take_profits array populated from singular take_profit/_2/_3 via normaliser at /app/frontend/src/components/AISuggestionsSheet.tsx:253 + canTrade gate at :255). Bug 2 (PICK A SIGNAL always said CONFLUENCE): fixed — with trader-profile:v1='scalper' in storage, AI Suggestions engine chip shows 'VWAP-SCALPER' (was always 'CONFLUENCE' pre-fix); asi-bot.tsx now imports useTraderProfile and maps traderProfile→apiProfile (lines 174-177) and auto-saves bot.profile when traderProfile changes (lines 92-101). Backend engine routing verified via parametrised tests: scalper→VWAP-SCALPER, day→VWAP-INTRADAY (NOTE: review request wrote 'VWAP-DAY' but backend label is VWAP-INTRADAY — intentional, see server.py:804), swing→VWAP-SWING, confluence/no-profile→CONFLUENCE. Bug 3 (false need_connect alert race): fixed — credsLoaded flag added (asi-bot.tsx:49, set true in refresh() finally at :113), pickTopSignal gates alert behind `credsLoaded && !canUseBot` (:165) so alert only fires after first refresh completes. ASI-Bot profile round-trip persistence verified for all 4 values (scalper/day/swing/confluence) via POST→GET. Frontend asi-bot top card still shows green SEMI-AUTO · READY frame with pink PICK A SIGNAL button and SEMI badge (iter33 regression intact). Regression: close unknown trade→404; GET /asi/trades _id is string; GET /asi/leaderboard/live sorted desc by unrealized_pct (profit-only invariant preserved).

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 RCA: AISuggestionsSheet.tsx previously filtered on asset.take_profits (plural array) but backend AssetSignal model exposes take_profit + take_profit_2 + take_profit_3 (singular). canTrade therefore evaluated false for every crypto card → EXECUTE SEMI-AUTO button never rendered. Fix: build tps[] = [take_profit, take_profit_2, take_profit_3].filter(number) and gate canTrade on tps.length>0. Button is now rendered in the card main body (outside the expand toggle) so even collapsed cards expose the Semi-Auto 1-tap entry. Bug 2 RCA: asi-bot.tsx pickTopSignal passed bot.profile (backend config, default 'confluence') to api.aiSuggestions instead of reading the global useTraderProfile() store that drives the header icon and modal picker. Fix: map traderProfile (scalper/day/swing/longterm) → apiProfile (scalper/day/swing/confluence) with explicit guard on traderExplicit; also auto-save bot.profile so Full-Auto scheduler mirrors Semi-Auto. Bug 3 RCA: 'Butuh Koneksi + Persetujuan' alert fired synchronously inside pickTopSignal before refresh() populated creds state — tapping PICK before the first list fetch returned a race. Fix: credsLoaded flag flipped true in refresh() finally; alert only fires once credsLoaded && !canUseBot.
